notes.text: The minor in Comedy (Performance) is a 16-unit minor for students who want to develop their comedic presence for a range of fields. Beginning with a foundation in the history of comic performance, students then select from comedy electives that focus on using improv, stand-up, clowning, and other forms of humor to be more effective and entertaining in any professional setting. The progression of the minor offers students a comprehensive theoretical and experiential education in the many differing disciplines of comedy.
